technical_and_design_decisions: Utilize Spring Boot and Spring XD framework for container management and data processing.
Integrate Docker management using Java Docker client libraries (e.g., Docker Java) for programmatic container configuration.
Implement service discovery with Spring Cloud Netflix (Eureka) or Consul for dynamic process and service communication.
Set up CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins or GitLab CI with Docker for automated image building, testing, and deployment.
Leverage Spring Batch for data partitioning and commit-interval configurations in OOTB jobs.
Use configuration properties in servers.yml or application.yml for user-configurable options like commit-interval.
Develop new HDFS source module as a Spring Batch item reader to support direct data ingestion.
Ensure compatibility with Mesos and Marathon Frameworks for deployment recommendations.
assumptions: The development environment includes access to the existing Spring XD or similar codebase and necessary tools.
External services like RabbitMQ, Redis, etc., are available for testing linkage configurations.
No major architectural changes are required; enhancements are additive to the current system.
Developers have expertise in Spring, Docker, and CI/CD practices.
CI/CD infrastructure (e.g., Jenkins server) is pre-configured for pipeline setup.
Documentation can be based on standard deployment patterns with minimal custom research.
Dependency upgrades for Spring Boot are feasible without breaking core functionalities.
Configuration files like servers.yml are already part of the system for property management.

activities.activity_name: Analysis and Design for Docker XD Configuration
activities.activity_description: Analyze requirements for U1 and U2, design the configuration model for Docker containers including linking attributes, environment variables, and service discovery integration.

activities.activity_name: Implementation of Docker Linking and Environment Variables
activities.activity_description: Develop functionality to configure Docker XD containers for linking to external services (Rabbit, Redis, Zookeeper, etc.) via attributes and environment variables, as per U1.

activities.activity_name: Implementation of Service Discovery for Docker XD
activities.activity_description: Integrate service discovery mechanisms to enable tools for managing process and service communication in a cluster, as per U2.

activities.activity_name: CI/CD Pipeline Setup for Docker Image Creation
activities.activity_description: Set up CI/CD pipeline to automate building, testing, and deploying Docker images for components and configurations, as per U3.
Create technical documentation covering recommendations for deploying an XD cluster using Mesos with the Marathon Framework, as per U4.
Evaluate Spring Boot dependency upgrades to identify and mitigate side effects or impacts on existing functionalities, as per U5.
Develop an option for users to supply data partitioning strategies to parallelize ingest from RDBMS to HDFS, as per U6.
Create an HDFS source module to allow users to ingest data directly from the HDFS file system, as per U7.
Implement the ability to override the default commit-interval for OOTB jobs with partition support, configurable via servers.yml, as per U8.
